chapter: Early freelance work and New Orleans trumpeters
title: Kid Rena's style and the Gypsy Tea Room band
summary: Kid Rena was more modern than Petit, powerful, strong in the high register and in all keys. He never let a band member down, and Dejan recalls the Gypsy Tea Room band.
